item.description:

He argues that many headlines are designed to grab attention rather than provide useful information, focusing on topics like AI development and US Treasury yields. Levitt emphasizes that while concerns exist, underlying economic fundamentals for households and corporations remain strong, and historical context often reveals that current challenges are not as dire as they appear.

item.description:

Their joint effort, presented at the TSMC 2026 North America Open Innovation Platform Ecosystem Forum, focuses on integrating Synopsys' 224G PHY IP with Alchip's advanced packaging and signal/power integrity expertise. This collaboration aims to overcome physical design challenges at high SerDes speeds and achieve ultra-high-density interconnect bandwidth, setting a foundation for future 448G SerDes implementations.

This development highlights how AI models could accelerate pharmaceutical R&D, benefiting both the drug company seeking new molecules and the chip supplier expanding the ecosystem for its hardware and software.
